calculation_steps.action: Retrieve deal.FirstPayDate and deal.HolidayScheduleName.
Resolve the holiday schedule object: holiday_schedules[deal.HolidayScheduleName].
Call holiday_schedules[deal.HolidayScheduleName].is_holiday(deal.FirstPayDate) to determine if the date is a configured holiday.

Determine the weekday label corresponding to deal.FirstPayDate and compare it against holiday_schedules[deal.HolidayScheduleName].weekend_days. NOTE: the pasted ASAP_SCRIPTING_MANUAL documents the weekend_days return format (e.g., ['Sun','Sat']) and the is_holiday() method signature, but does not document a built-in ASAP function that derives a weekday label from a date or that combines both checks into a single 'is_business_day' call; this step relies on an unresolved implementation detail (see unresolved_questions).

If is_holiday(...) returns True OR the derived weekday label is present in weekend_days, invoke deal.raise_error with severity = THRESHOLD value (5) and message = 'First Pay Date is on a weekend or holiday'; otherwise no error is raised for this condition.

validation_logic.description: First Pay Date must not fall on a weekend day or a configured holiday.

validation_logic.fail_condition: holiday_schedules[deal.HolidayScheduleName].is_holiday(deal.FirstPayDate) is True OR the weekday label of deal.FirstPayDate is present in holiday_schedules[deal.HolidayScheduleName].weekend_days.
